content.title: Starbucks Easter 2025 opening times: Are stores closed during the spring holiday?
content.text: WHEN it comes to coffee, Starbucks is the gift that keeps on giving. However, some people may be wondering if the famous chain will be open over Easter. Here’s what we know. Sign up for the Money newsletter Thank you! Starbucks fans are keen to know if they can grab a coffee over the Easter holidaysCredit: Getty While most locations are typically open on Good Friday, opening hours may vary depending on demandCredit: Alamy Grabbing a Starbucks is a staple of most Americans’ daily routine. The coffee chain usually opens its stores from 6am to 8pm, Monday to Sunday. The hours may vary by location, and some Starbucks locations are open 24/7, especially in busy areas like airports and major cities. However, over the holidays the opening hours may change. Easter 2025 opening hours The good news is Starbucks stores typically remain open over the Easter holidays. Good Friday (April 18, 2025): Starbucks locations are typically open on Good Friday, and while opening hours usually follow regular schedules, some stores might adjust based on local demand Easter Sunday (April 20, 2025): Many Starbucks locations are open on Easter Sunday, but some may have reduced hours or be closed entirely Easter Monday (April 21, 2025): Easter Monday is not a federal holiday in the US, so Starbucks stores generally operate using their regular schedules However, opening times may vary by location, so it is best to check your specific store’s hours using either the Starbucks app or store locator. Who owns Starbucks? Starbucks is a publicly-traded company, which means it’s owned by shareholders. Most read in Money The Vanguard Group owns around nine per cent of Starbucks, making it the majority owner with over 1,500 shareholders. In September 2024, Brian Nicol took over from Laxman Narasimhan — who held the position from March 2024 — to become the CEO of Starbucks. He became CEO in 2017, having served as a board member for Starbucks since 2009. Before Johnson, there were a few different CEOs. Orin C. Smith served as the company’s president and chief executive officer between 2000 and 2005, while Jim Donald served between 2005 and 2008. Howard Schultz both preceded and succeeded these men, and was the CEO between 1986 and 2000, followed by 2008 through 2017. Under Schultz, nearly $100billion was added to the company’s market capitalization. He also introduced the Starbucks College Achievement Plan in 2014, allowing employees who work 20 or more hours a week to receive free online schooling through Arizona State University. In 1971, Starbucks was founded by business partners Jerry Baldwin, Zev Siegl and Gordon Bowker. The trio also purchased Peet’s Coffee in 1984, selling the Starbucks name to Shultz just three years later.
